name: dazzle_bands
theme: one Turing stripe at three scales under a hard noon sun in Horn-of-Africa scrub — a waterhole seated in a bare band of tiger bush where Grevy's zebras drink, dived into one zebra's flank at the frontier of a jet stripe and an ivory one, down into the follicle bulb where the stripe is decided cell by cell, into a pigment granule whose protein sheets are themselves striped, which morphs up into the banded country seen from the air and comes home to the waterhole

registers.name: waterhole_commons
registers.palette: rust-red laterite, acid-green shrub bands, jet and ivory stripes, one turquoise accent
registers.scene: a banded-scrub waterhole at hard noon seen low and oblique from the rim of the bare ground, the muddy pool seated in one wide band of rust-red laterite with bands of acid-green shrub running parallel across the country in back of it, a herd of Grevy's zebras drinking at the water's edge, jet stripes dense on their flanks, red-billed oxpeckers perched on the zebras' backs, two beisa oryx with straight black horns standing at the far rim, a Somali ostrich with a blue-grey neck in the bare band, a dik-dik in the shrub band, a turquoise-and-lilac roller perched on a dead branch, weaver nests hanging in a flat-topped acacia, animal paths converging on the pool across the rust earth, a hard blue sky, no people present
registers.loop_target: a muddy waterhole in a band of rust-red laterite, Grevy's zebras drinking among acid-green shrub bands

registers.name: stripe_frontier
registers.palette: jet-black and ivory hair, slate-blue skin, rust dust
registers.scene: a zebra's flank at the frontier of a jet-black stripe and an ivory stripe, thousands of stiff hair shafts standing in dense slanted files, the jet files and the ivory files meeting at a sharp wavering edge, slate-blue skin showing at the hair roots, rust-red laterite dust caught in the hair, a single tick-bitten furrow where an oxpecker has fed, dark follicle openings dotted across the skin at the foot of every shaft

registers.name: follicle_bulb
registers.palette: hot magenta cells, jet granules, ivory files, tangerine membranes
registers.scene: the bulb at a hair's root, a crowd of tall hot-magenta cells packed in upward files with tangerine membranes, a few branching pigment cells seated among them with long arms reaching into their neighbours and pushing jet granules into them, the files on one flank of a frontier loaded jet-black and the files on the other left ivory, a mesh of crimson capillaries cupping the base of the bulb, countless jet granules strewn through the magenta crowd

registers.name: melanosome_matrix
registers.palette: teal protein sheets, jet pigment beads, violet membrane
registers.scene: the interior of one pigment granule, a stack of parallel teal protein sheets set a few nanometres apart and seen edge-on, jet pigment beads laid in close rows on every sheet so the whole granule reads as stripes, teal and jet banding repeating across the interior, a curved violet membrane wall enclosing the stack, no ground and no horizon

registers.name: tiger_bush_air
registers.palette: acid-green shrub bands, rust-red bare bands, one mud-brown pool
registers.scene: tiger bush from low overhead at hard noon, bands of dense acid-green shrub alternating with bands of bare rust-red laterite, each band a few tens of metres wide and running in parallel wavering stripes across the gentle slope, a muddy waterhole seated in one bare band with ochre-dust animal paths converging on it, tiny zebras and oryx dotted on the rust ground at its rim, flat-topped acacias standing in the shrub bands, a hard blue haze at the horizon

music_theme: a hard noon over banded scrub — warm tape-worn keys and a dry plucked figure over a deep kick landing on the downbeat of every scale change, the figure tightening into a striped staccato through the hair and the follicle bars, a wide swell where the pigment granule's stripes morph up into the banded country, and an open settling chord as the waterhole comes home
